title: ColdGuard event envelope v1
description: Common envelope of every domain event published on exchange coldguard.events. Event-specific schemas constrain eventType, producer, aggregateType and payload.

eventId.description: Unique per event; also the AMQP message_id and the consumer idempotency key.

aggregateVersion.description: Monotonic sequence of the event within its aggregate (1, 2, 3...). Consumers that keep per-aggregate state apply an event only when it is the next expected one. Absent in events from producers that do not sequence yet.

actor.description: Who caused the event: a user id, or SYSTEM plus the process name (e.g. calibration-expiry-job).
